name: Dropping Web Trap
disable: DC 15 Crafting check or DC 18 Thievery check to secure the bridge in place.

items.name: Collapse
items.text:
Trigger One Large, two Medium, or three Small creatures move onto the rope bridge

Effect The bridge collapses and creatures on the bridge fall 30 feet, taking 15 bludgeoning damage. The triggering creatures can attempt a DC 18 Reflex save save to Grab an Edge to avoid falling.

text: A 30-foot-wide rope bridge spans a 30-foot‑deep chasm between two crags on the mountainside.
